blocks.text: Ritual identity.

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: Recognition of emptiness.

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: Recognition of divine consciousness.

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: Yet the underlying question recurs.

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: Is the person prepared for what they understand death to involve?

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: The deepest death yoga may therefore have nothing to do with physically abandoning the body.

blocks.text: It concerns the transformation of understanding while life is still available.

blocks.section: IX. GREECE, INDIA AND TIBET: The dead must remember somethin
blocks.text: And this is where our entire trilogy comes together.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.directed: [long pause] X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: After this journey, we can finally answer the user's central comparative question without pretending humanity agrees on one universal soul theory.
blocks.directed: After this journey, we can finally answer the user's central comparative question without pretending humanity agrees on one universal soul theory.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: There are several fundamentally different accounts of what remains.
blocks.directed: There are several fundamentally different accounts of what remains.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Tradition: What is understood to continue? Ancient Egypt: Multiple aspects of the deceased, transformed into an effective postmortem existence Inca and other Andean contexts: Ancestral personhood, connected with remains, descendants, sacred places and continuing relationships Islam: The person remains subject to God's power, awaiting resurrection and judgment; interpretations of the intermediate state vary Chinese ancestral traditions: Differentiated spiritual aspects, ancestor presence, ritual relationships and, in some accounts, rebirth Yoruba traditions: Ancestral presence and, in some settings, return within a lineage Nahua traditions: Different vital aspects of the person and postmortem destinies connected with modes of death Zoroastrianism: The soul, which encounters judgment and the manifestation of its moral character Tibetan Buddhism: A causally continuous mental process without a permanent independent self Trika Śaivism: The karmically conditioned individual continues in bondage; ultimate consciousness is Śiva, which never truly departs
blocks.directed: Tradition: What is understood to continue? blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: These positions cannot all be literally true in precisely the way their historical adherents describe them.
blocks.directed: These positions cannot all be literally true in precisely the way their historical adherents describe them.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: For example, an eternal personal soul and a doctrine denying any permanent independent self present a genuine philosophical disagreement.
blocks.directed: For example, an eternal personal soul and a doctrine denying any permanent independent self present a genuine philosophical disagreement.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: A single final resurrection is not the same event as endless karmic rebirth.
blocks.directed: A single final resurrection is not the same event as endless karmic rebirth.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: And the continuing political power of an ancestral mummy is not evidence of a detectable mental continuum surviving death.
blocks.directed: And the continuing political power of an ancestral mummy is not evidence of a detectable mental continuum surviving death.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: But across the traditions, we can identify three broader kinds of continuity.
blocks.directed: But across the traditions, we can identify three broader kinds of continuity.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The continuity of matter
blocks.directed: The continuity of matter

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: This one is observable.
blocks.directed: This one is observable.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The organism dies.
blocks.directed: The organism dies.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Its matter undergoes physical transformations.
blocks.directed: Its matter undergoes physical transformations.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The body returns to the biological and geological systems from which its elements were drawn.
blocks.directed: The body returns to the biological and geological systems from which its elements were drawn.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The matter persists in changing forms, although the living organism does not.
blocks.directed: The matter persists in changing forms, although the living organism does not.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: That is physical continuity, not personal immortality.
blocks.directed: That is physical continuity, not personal immortality.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The continuity of consequences
blocks.directed: The continuity of consequences

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: This too is observable within life and society.
blocks.directed: This too is observable within life and society.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Actions produce effects that continue after the actor dies.
blocks.directed: Actions produce effects that continue after the actor dies.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Relationships persist in surviving people.
blocks.directed: Relationships persist in surviving people.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Children inherit biological and cultural characteristics.
blocks.directed: Children inherit biological and cultural characteristics.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Institutions continue.
blocks.directed: Institutions continue.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Memories survive in others.
blocks.directed: Memories survive in others.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The dead remain causally influential in the world they leave behind.
blocks.directed: The dead remain causally influential in the world they leave behind.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: This is a powerful meaning of continuity, but it is not equivalent to subjective survival.
blocks.directed: This is a powerful meaning of continuity, but it is not equivalent to subjective survival.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The proposed continuity of experience
blocks.directed: The proposed continuity of experience

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Here we enter the contested territory.
blocks.directed: Here we enter the contested territory.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: A soul.
blocks.directed: A soul.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: A subtle body.
blocks.directed: A subtle body.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: A consciousness continuum.
blocks.directed: A consciousness continuum.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: An ancestral spirit.
blocks.directed: An ancestral spirit.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: An imaginal postmortem existence.
blocks.directed: An imaginal postmortem existence.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: These are different religious explanations of how personal or experiential continuity might extend beyond physical death.
blocks.directed: These are different religious explanations of how personal or experiential continuity might extend beyond physical death.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: The traditions supply elaborate metaphysical theories.
blocks.directed: The traditions supply elaborate metaphysical theories.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: But no particular supernatural mechanism has been scientifically demonstrated to be a general feature of human death.
blocks.directed: But no particular supernatural mechanism has been scientifically demonstrated to be a general feature of human death.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: That distinction is critical.
blocks.directed: That distinction is critical.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Something about every human being continues causally after death. Whether their subjective experience continues is a separate and unresolved question.
blocks.directed: Something about every human being continues causally after death. Whether their subjective experience continues is a separate and unresolved question.

blocks.section: X. WHAT ACTUALLY REMAINS? THE FINAL VERDICT
blocks.text: Now we've reached the heart of the whole inquiry.
blocks.directed: Now we've reached the heart of the whole inquiry.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.directed: [long pause] XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: If we remove the differences in supernatural cosmology, what recurring insights remain?
blocks.directed: If we remove the differences in supernatural cosmology, what recurring insights remain?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The first is that human identity is not straightforward.
blocks.directed: The first is that human identity is not straightforward.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Egyptians divided personhood into multiple aspects.
blocks.directed: The Egyptians divided personhood into multiple aspects.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Chinese developed differentiated concepts of vital and spiritual continuity.
blocks.directed: The Chinese developed differentiated concepts of vital and spiritual continuity.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Nahua understood several animating forces.
blocks.directed: The Nahua understood several animating forces.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Buddhists analyzed the person as a dependently arisen process.
blocks.directed: The Buddhists analyzed the person as a dependently arisen process.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Trika philosophers distinguished the limited experiencer from universal consciousness.
blocks.directed: The Trika philosophers distinguished the limited experiencer from universal consciousness.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The questions these traditions raise are profound even when their answers conflict.
blocks.directed: The questions these traditions raise are profound even when their answers conflict.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: What is a person?
blocks.directed: What is a person?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: What constitutes identity?
blocks.directed: What constitutes identity?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: What makes a life one continuous life?
blocks.directed: What makes a life one continuous life?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Does the organism exhaust what we mean by self?
blocks.directed: Does the organism exhaust what we mean by self?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The second insight is that death concerns relationships as well as bodies.
blocks.directed: The second insight is that death concerns relationships as well as bodies.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Andean ancestor.
blocks.directed: The Andean ancestor.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Chinese family altar.
blocks.directed: The Chinese family altar.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Yoruba ancestral masquerade.
blocks.directed: The Yoruba ancestral masquerade.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Toraja funeral.
blocks.directed: The Toraja funeral.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The Egyptian offerings.
blocks.directed: The Egyptian offerings.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Different manifestations of a basic human predicament.
blocks.directed: Different manifestations of a basic human predicament.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: When somebody dies, the living must reorganize a world in which that person mattered.
blocks.directed: When somebody dies, the living must reorganize a world in which that person mattered.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: The third is that the manner of living and dying can carry religious significance.
blocks.directed: The third is that the manner of living and dying can carry religious significance.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: In some traditions, moral character governs destiny.
blocks.directed: In some traditions, moral character governs destiny.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: In others, ritual knowledge matters.
blocks.directed: In others, ritual knowledge matters.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: In others, the manner of death is significant.
blocks.directed: In others, the manner of death is significant.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: In still others, liberation depends on recognizing a truth that transcends the ordinary person.
blocks.directed: In still others, liberation depends on recognizing a truth that transcends the ordinary person.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: These positions aren't interchangeable.
blocks.directed: These positions aren't interchangeable.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: But they all challenge the idea that death can be understood adequately as a purely technical problem of biological shutdown.
blocks.directed: But they all challenge the idea that death can be understood adequately as a purely technical problem of biological shutdown.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: And here's the greatest point of disagreement.
blocks.directed: And here's the greatest point of disagreement.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Is the highest goal to continue existing-or to become free from the very conditions that make ordinary existence a problem?
blocks.directed: Is the highest goal to continue existing-or to become free from the very conditions that make ordinary existence a problem?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Ancient Egyptian mortuary religion places enormous emphasis on successful postmortem existence.
blocks.directed: Ancient Egyptian mortuary religion places enormous emphasis on successful postmortem existence.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Andean ancestor traditions can preserve the deceased's continuing participation in family and society.
blocks.directed: Andean ancestor traditions can preserve the deceased's continuing participation in family and society.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Islam emphasizes resurrection, judgment and the final destiny of the person under God.
blocks.directed: Islam emphasizes resurrection, judgment and the final destiny of the person under God.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: But Buddhism and Trika introduce a more radical concern.
blocks.directed: But Buddhism and Trika introduce a more radical concern.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Not merely survival.
blocks.directed: Not merely survival.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Liberation.
blocks.directed: Liberation.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: For Buddhism, the problem is ignorance and grasping, producing continuing conditioned existence.
blocks.directed: For Buddhism, the problem is ignorance and grasping, producing continuing conditioned existence.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: For Trika, the problem is the contraction through which universal consciousness appears as a limited being.
blocks.directed: For Trika, the problem is the contraction through which universal consciousness appears as a limited being.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: So even if one established that consciousness could survive death, a fundamental question would remain.
blocks.directed: So even if one established that consciousness could survive death, a fundamental question would remain.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Would survival itself be a good thing?
blocks.directed: Would survival itself be a good thing?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: If the individual survives while remaining ignorant, frightened, grasping and bound, what exactly has been accomplished?
blocks.directed: If the individual survives while remaining ignorant, frightened, grasping and bound, what exactly has been accomplished?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: An extra lifetime?
blocks.directed: An extra lifetime?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: A different body?
blocks.directed: A different body?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: A more favorable world?
blocks.directed: A more favorable world?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: And how long until the same problem returns?
blocks.directed: And how long until the same problem returns?

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: Abhinavagupta and the Buddhist masters are not merely trying to win the struggle for continued existence.
blocks.directed: Abhinavagupta and the Buddhist masters are not merely trying to win the struggle for continued existence.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: They are investigating the basis of the struggle.
blocks.directed: They are investigating the basis of the struggle.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: That's what makes them so philosophically unusual.
blocks.directed: That's what makes them so philosophically unusual.

blocks.section: XI. THE GREAT HUMAN AGREEMENT-AND THE GREAT DISAGREEMENT
blocks.text: And now we can finally end this trilogy properly.
blocks.directed: And now we can finally end this trilogy properly.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.directed: [long pause] XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Imagine every civilization we've visited gathered beside one dying person.
blocks.directed: Imagine every civilization we've visited gathered beside one dying person.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: An Egyptian priest stands beside the bed, concerned with preserving the components of the person's existence.
blocks.directed: An Egyptian priest stands beside the bed, concerned with preserving the components of the person's existence.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: An Andean descendant brings an offering, refusing to believe that death abolishes ancestral relationship.
blocks.directed: An Andean descendant brings an offering, refusing to believe that death abolishes ancestral relationship.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: An Islamic scholar speaks of returning to God and the gravity of resurrection and judgment.
blocks.directed: An Islamic scholar speaks of returning to God and the gravity of resurrection and judgment.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A Chinese descendant tends the ancestor's name.
blocks.directed: A Chinese descendant tends the ancestor's name.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A Yoruba elder remembers that the generations are connected.
blocks.directed: A Yoruba elder remembers that the generations are connected.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A Zoroastrian priest considers the consequences of the dying person's thoughts, words and deeds.
blocks.directed: A Zoroastrian priest considers the consequences of the dying person's thoughts, words and deeds.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A Greek initiate remembers the sacred instructions.
blocks.directed: A Greek initiate remembers the sacred instructions.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A Tibetan master speaks of the nature of mind.
blocks.directed: A Tibetan master speaks of the nature of mind.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And a Śaiva philosopher contemplates the recognition of consciousness.
blocks.directed: And a Śaiva philosopher contemplates the recognition of consciousness.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They don't all agree.
blocks.directed: They don't all agree.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some think the person will be resurrected.
blocks.directed: Some think the person will be resurrected.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some think they may be reborn.
blocks.directed: Some think they may be reborn.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some imagine different aspects of the person undergoing different transitions.
blocks.directed: Some imagine different aspects of the person undergoing different transitions.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some understand the dead as continuing through the community.
blocks.directed: Some understand the dead as continuing through the community.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some speak of ultimate realization beyond the ordinary individual.
blocks.directed: Some speak of ultimate realization beyond the ordinary individual.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They have different gods, different ontologies, different rituals, different languages and different answers.
blocks.directed: They have different gods, different ontologies, different rituals, different languages and different answers.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: But every one of them confronts the same disappearing life.
blocks.directed: But every one of them confronts the same disappearing life.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The person's eyes close.
blocks.directed: The person's eyes close.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The breathing eventually ceases.
blocks.directed: The breathing eventually ceases.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The physical organism reaches its end.
blocks.directed: The physical organism reaches its end.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And whatever religious interpretation one adopts, something undeniable has happened.
blocks.directed: And whatever religious interpretation one adopts, something undeniable has happened.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: A unique embodied life is over.
blocks.directed: A unique embodied life is over.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: No more ordinary conversations.
blocks.directed: No more ordinary conversations.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: No more opportunities for that person to finish their work.
blocks.directed: No more opportunities for that person to finish their work.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: No more chances to say what they never said.
blocks.directed: No more chances to say what they never said.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: No more moments in which the world appears through that particular living organism.
blocks.directed: No more moments in which the world appears through that particular living organism.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And the people standing around the bed are left asking what, if anything, continues.
blocks.directed: And the people standing around the bed are left asking what, if anything, continues.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some will pray.
blocks.directed: Some will pray.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some will perform rites.
blocks.directed: Some will perform rites.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some will contemplate impermanence.
blocks.directed: Some will contemplate impermanence.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some will remember.
blocks.directed: Some will remember.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some will believe that the individual has entered another realm.
blocks.directed: Some will believe that the individual has entered another realm.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Others will believe that death is final.
blocks.directed: Others will believe that death is final.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The disagreement remains.
blocks.directed: The disagreement remains.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: But the living can still ask what this uncertainty means for their own lives.
blocks.directed: But the living can still ask what this uncertainty means for their own lives.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Now imagine that person is you.
blocks.directed: Now imagine that person is you.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Not the theoretical future you.
blocks.directed: Not the theoretical future you.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Not the abstract mortal human discussed in a philosophy seminar.
blocks.directed: Not the abstract mortal human discussed in a philosophy seminar.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: You.
blocks.directed: You.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The being experiencing these words.
blocks.directed: The being experiencing these words.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The one who has constructed an identity around a particular body, a particular history, and an extraordinary series of hopes and anxieties.
blocks.directed: The one who has constructed an identity around a particular body, a particular history, and an extraordinary series of hopes and anxieties.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH

blocks.text: And still one question will remain unanswered until you've examined your own experience:

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: What is the relationship between consciousness, the person you believe yourself to be, and the body through which the world presently appears?
blocks.directed: What is the relationship between consciousness, the person you believe yourself to be, and the body through which the world presently appears?

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The Egyptians developed a ritual technology for continuing existence.
blocks.directed: The Egyptians developed a ritual technology for continuing existence.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The Andeans maintained the presence of the ancestors.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The Islamic tradition proclaimed resurrection and accountability.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The Buddhist philosophers investigated the causal processes through which suffering continues.
blocks.directed: The Buddhist philosophers investigated the causal processes through which suffering continues.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The Trika masters investigated the ultimate reality of consciousness itself.
blocks.directed: The Trika masters investigated the ultimate reality of consciousness itself.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: You don't have to pretend they agree.
blocks.directed: You don't have to pretend they agree.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: You have to understand what each one is actually claiming.
blocks.directed: You have to understand what each one is actually claiming.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And then you have to do something far more difficult than collecting beautiful religious theories.
blocks.directed: And then you have to do something far more difficult than collecting beautiful religious theories.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: You have to examine the life you're living.
blocks.directed: You have to examine the life you're living.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: How much of it is organized around fear?
blocks.directed: How much of it is organized around fear?

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: How much around craving?
blocks.directed: How much around craving?

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: How much around the compulsive defense of an identity that changes every day?
blocks.directed: How much around the compulsive defense of an identity that changes every day?

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: How much around the avoidance of a question that cannot be avoided forever?

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The dead have left us their pyramids, manuscripts, ancestral shrines, funerary songs, sacred diagrams and philosophical arguments.
blocks.directed: The dead have left us their pyramids, manuscripts, ancestral shrines, funerary songs, sacred diagrams and philosophical arguments.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: An almost unimaginable archive of human beings trying to understand what it means to exist.
blocks.directed: An almost unimaginable archive of human beings trying to understand what it means to exist.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some of their answers may be wrong.
blocks.directed: Some of their answers may be wrong.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some may contain insights we haven't fully appreciated.
blocks.directed: Some may contain insights we haven't fully appreciated.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Some may describe phenomena that remain difficult to investigate.
blocks.directed: Some may describe phenomena that remain difficult to investigate.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: But their greatest gift may not be an answer about the afterlife.
blocks.directed: But their greatest gift may not be an answer about the afterlife.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: It may be the force with which they compel us to confront the present one.
blocks.directed: It may be the force with which they compel us to confront the present one.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Because here, at the end of our trilogy, the most important discovery is not that everyone agrees consciousness survives death.
blocks.directed: Because here, at the end of our trilogy, the most important discovery is not that everyone agrees consciousness survives death.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They don't.
blocks.directed: They don't.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: It isn't that everyone agrees the soul reincarnates.
blocks.directed: It isn't that everyone agrees the soul reincarnates.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They don't.
blocks.directed: They don't.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: It isn't that everyone agrees moral actions determine the next world.
blocks.directed: It isn't that everyone agrees moral actions determine the next world.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They don't.
blocks.directed: They don't.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The astonishing common ground is that human beings, across radically different civilizations, have refused to regard death as unworthy of their deepest attention.
blocks.directed: The astonishing common ground is that human beings, across radically different civilizations, have refused to regard death as unworthy of their deepest attention.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: They have confronted it through reason, ritual, memory, love, terror, philosophical investigation and the desire for liberation.
blocks.directed: They have confronted it through reason, ritual, memory, love, terror, philosophical investigation and the desire for liberation.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And they have left us with one responsibility.
blocks.directed: And they have left us with one responsibility.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Do not waste the opportunity to understand your own existence while you can still investigate it.
blocks.directed: Do not waste the opportunity to understand your own existence while you can still investigate it.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Perhaps this is your only life.
blocks.directed: Perhaps this is your only life.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Perhaps there are further lives.
blocks.directed: Perhaps there are further lives.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Perhaps the deepest reality of consciousness is very different from the way you currently conceive it.
blocks.directed: Perhaps the deepest reality of consciousness is very different from the way you currently conceive it.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: No amount of rhetorical grandeur can settle those questions.
blocks.directed: No amount of rhetorical grandeur can settle those questions.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: But uncertainty is not a reason to remain asleep.
blocks.directed: But uncertainty is not a reason to remain asleep.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The present life is real.
blocks.directed: The present life is real.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Its suffering is real.
blocks.directed: Its suffering is real.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Its relationships matter.
blocks.directed: Its relationships matter.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Its consequences extend beyond you in ways that are already visible.
blocks.directed: Its consequences extend beyond you in ways that are already visible.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And its duration is limited.
blocks.directed: And its duration is limited.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: So study.
blocks.directed: So study.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Question.
blocks.directed: Question.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Practice intelligently.
blocks.directed: Practice intelligently.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Care for the living.
blocks.directed: Care for the living.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Honor the dead.
blocks.directed: Honor the dead.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Do not mistake belief for knowledge or extraordinary experiences for liberation.
blocks.directed: Do not mistake belief for knowledge or extraordinary experiences for liberation.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And above all, do not confuse the accumulation of explanations with the understanding of what those explanations are meant to illuminate.
blocks.directed: And above all, do not confuse the accumulation of explanations with the understanding of what those explanations are meant to illuminate.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Because one day, the philosophers will be silent.
blocks.directed: Because one day, the philosophers will be silent.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The books will be closed.
blocks.directed: The books will be closed.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: The body will no longer sustain the familiar world.
blocks.directed: The body will no longer sustain the familiar world.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: And whatever happens after that, you will have already lived this life.
blocks.directed: And whatever happens after that, you will have already lived this life.

blocks.section: XII. THE LAST FUNERAL ON EARTH
blocks.text: Make it one in which you genuinely investigated what you were.
